components.name: HalationProvider
components.use: Wrap the app once. Sets accent, tempo and theme, hosts tooltips and toasts, and puts on the project's signature.

components.name: Text
components.use: Any running text, in one of the ten styles (size) with an optional tone: muted, subtle, accent or critical.

components.name: Heading
components.use: Headlines. level sets the element and its default style (1 is display-xl, 3 is title-1); size overrides the style.

components.name: Serif
components.use: The one italic serif phrase inside a headline, at title sizes and up (R8).

components.name: Value
components.use: A number with tabular figures and a quieter unit.

components.name: Button
components.use: Actions. One ink button per view for the main action; secondary (the default) or ghost for the rest; critical for destructive ones. busy/busyLabel and done/doneLabel change the label in place.
components.example: <Button variant="ink" busy={saving} busyLabel="Saving" done={saved} doneLabel="Saved">Save changes</Button>

components.name: Kbd
components.use: A single key.

components.name: Keys
components.use: A keyboard shortcut; each key on its own cap with a gap (R16).

components.name: State
components.use: A status as a word and a glyph, never a colored dot (R10). Kinds: running, done, selected, info, draft, warning, critical.

components.name: Facts
components.use: Metadata about a thing: labels and values on their own lines, instead of facts joined with dots (R9).

components.name: Fact
components.use: One label and value inside Facts, when the value is richer than a string.

components.name: Surface
components.use: A box, only when something must read as an object (R13). elevation: flat, raised or overlay. Never put one inside another.

components.name: Divider
components.use: A hairline between groups; the first choice before a box.

components.name: List
components.use: A list of rows separated by hairlines.

components.name: ListRow
components.use: A row: something leading, a title with an optional detail, and something trailing. selected marks it chosen.
components.example: <ListRow leading={<Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" />} title="Ada Lovelace" detail="Owner" trailing={<Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Remove</Button>} />

components.name: Field
components.use: A labelled control with an optional description and an error that says what's wrong and how to fix it.
components.example: <Field label="Project name" description="Shown on the seal." error={error}><Input name="name" /></Field>

components.name: Input
components.use: A single-line text input, usually inside Field.

components.name: Textarea
components.use: Multi-line text, inside Field.

components.name: Checkbox
components.use: An independent yes or no that takes effect when the form is saved.
components.example: <Checkbox label="Email me when it's done" defaultChecked />

components.name: Radio
components.use: One option in a RadioGroup.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.use: One choice out of a few, with each option visible.

components.name: Switch
components.use: An on or off setting that takes effect at once.

components.name: Slider
components.use: A value picked from a range.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.use: One of two to five views or modes, side by side.
components.example: <SegmentedControl aria-label="View" defaultValue="list" options={[{ value: "list", label: "List" }, { value: "grid", label: "Grid" }]} />

components.name: Tabs
components.use: Switching between panels of one page; the indicator glides between tabs.

components.name: Menu
components.use: Actions tucked behind a button. Items take an icon, keys for their shortcut, and tone="critical".

components.name: Popover
components.use: More detail or a small form anchored to a control.
components.example: <Popover.Root><Popover.Trigger render={<Button>Details</Button>} /><Popover.Popup title="Storage" description="What this project keeps on disk.">{details}</Popover.Popup></Popover.Root>

components.name: Tooltip
components.use: A short label for a control on hover or focus, with an optional shortcut.

components.name: TooltipProvider
components.use: Shares tooltip timing. HalationProvider already includes it; use it only for tooltips rendered outside the provider.

components.name: Select
components.use: One choice out of many, in a list.
components.example: <Select aria-label="Accent" defaultValue="vermilion" options={[{ value: "vermilion", label: "Vermilion" }, { value: "cobalt", label: "Cobalt" }]} />

components.name: Dialog
components.use: A decision that has to be made before going on. The page behind softens.
components.example: <Dialog.Root><Dialog.Trigger render={<Button variant="critical">Delete project</Button>} /><Dialog.Popup title="Delete this project?" description="Its files stay on disk." actions={<><Dialog.Close render={<Button>Cancel</Button>} /><Button variant="critical">Delete</Button></>} /></Dialog.Root>

components.name: Sheet
components.use: A panel you can pull away, from the bottom or the right, for filters, details or mobile menus.

components.name: ToastProvider
components.use: Hosts toasts. HalationProvider already includes it.

components.name: useToast
components.use: Confirms something finished, or reports a failure, without interrupting.
components.example: const toast = useToast(); toast({ title: "Saved", type: "success" })

components.name: Avatar
components.use: A person, as a photo or their initials.

components.name: Skeleton
components.use: A still placeholder while content loads. It never shimmers.

components.name: Count
components.use: A number that changes; its digits roll to the new value.

components.name: Rise
components.use: Content that arrives in reading order out of a soft blur, once, when first seen.

components.name: Stage
components.use: A hero with atmosphere: one phenomenon behind content, one per page (R15). Mark the headline data-quiet so it dims behind it.
components.example: <Stage phenomenon="caustics" settleAfter={12}><Heading level={1} data-quiet>Light on water</Heading></Stage>

components.name: Seal
components.use: The project's mark, generated from its name. Alt, Shift and a click opens the darkroom.

components.name: Colophon
components.use: The credits in a footer: what the project is made of.

components.name: Grain
components.use: Still film grain seeded by the name, laid over a stage or image.

components.name: ShareCard
components.use: The social share image, drawn from the name, a line and the accent.

components.name: useDevelop
components.use: Develops an element like a print, once per visitor. For a landing hero.

components.name: darkroom
components.use: Opens or closes the darkroom inspector from code.

components.name: useDarkroom
components.use: Whether the darkroom is open, for a button that enters and leaves it.

components.name: Lens
components.use: A command palette that pulls focus: a lit carriage on the chosen row, the rest softening with distance. For any app with more than a handful of places to go.
components.example: <Lens open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} groups={[{ name: "Copies", items: [{ id: "work", title: "Claude Work", onSelect: openWork }] }]} />

components.name: useLensShortcut
components.use: Opens Lens on ⌘K (Ctrl+K elsewhere).

components.name: ShortcutRecorder
components.use: Records a key combination with keycaps that go down while held. Refuses taken shortcuts and keys with no modifier, in words. Label it with what the shortcut does.
components.example: <ShortcutRecorder value={keys} onValueChange={setKeys} label="Switches to Claude Work" onMessage={setNote} />

components.name: TAKEN_SHORTCUTS
components.use: The shortcuts macOS keeps for itself, with the reason for each. Spread it into your own list of taken shortcuts.

components.name: Sundial
components.use: A time-of-day picker set by moving the sun, showing the real sky for that minute. For schedules and quiet hours; value is minutes after midnight.
components.example: <Sundial value={minutes} onValueChange={setMinutes} label="Quiet hours begin at" />

components.name: LitTabs
components.use: Tabs whose selection is a carriage of light; labels gain weight as it passes. Use for a page's main sections.

components.name: Dial
components.use: A rotary knob with detents that click, lit ticks and a rolling number. For intensity, volume, zoom: a value tuned by feel.

components.name: AccentForge
components.use: An accent picker that derives every accent role from a hue and shows each pair's contrast in both modes. Purple hues are closed.

components.name: LightTable
components.use: A file drop zone that backlights under the dragged file; dropped photos land as prints that develop. For uploads, avatars and imports.

components.name: icons
components.use: The system's glyphs: CheckIcon, PlayIcon, WrenchIcon, StopIcon, PencilIcon, InfoIcon, AlertIcon, ChevronIcon, CloseIcon. Use these or a real icon set, never emoji.

needs.need: A number in a column, or with a unit
Something that must read as an object
A form control with a label and error
On or off, applied at once
The project's mark, credits, share image
Let people set a keyboard shortcut
